topic: Earth materials in the environment and their uses
key_concepts: Environment is everything around us, including air, water, plants, animals, people, land,
There are different types of environments such as mountains, rivers, beaches, and farms.
Living things grow, move, respond, reproduce, and need food, water, and air.
Non-living things do not grow, move, respond, reproduce, or need food, water, and air.
Non-living materials in the environment are called earth materials.
Earth materials come from nature and are part of the Earth.
Examples of earth materials include rocks, soil, sand, water, minerals, and fossil fuels.
Water is used for drinking, cooking, cleaning, and growing plants.
Rocks are used to build roads and houses.
Minerals are used to make tools and jewelry.
Fossil fuels are used to make energy for cars and other vehicles.
Earth materials are useful and important to people.
